'''Thorsteg''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] mercenary hired by [[Marvid Qreph|Marvid]] and [[Craitheus Qreph]]. During the Qreph's [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] game with their prisoner [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], Thorsteg served as a table butler by fetching drinks and anything the players needed.<ref name="Crucible (novel)" />
